maddeler.e:
تقتطعوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِعُوا (taqtaṭiʕū) /taq.ta.tˤi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# تُقْتَطَعُوا (tuqtaṭaʕū) /tuq.ta.tˤa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
